- Updated `stock_indicators/indicators/common/quote.py` and `candles.py` (core conversion points)
- Updated all individual indicator files to import and use `to_pydecimal_via_double`
- Verified indicators still work correctly with tests
- Confirmed decimal conversion benchmarks show ~4x performance improvement (748ms → 186ms)
